apiDocumentation: OpenAPI 3.x (Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi built-in) — spec at /openapi/v1.json, UI via Scalar at /scalar/v1 (dev only)
requestValidation: Custom validators (TransactionValidator, CategoryValidator) in Finance.Api/Infrastructure/Validators/ — depend on ICategoryService for referential integrity
caching: In-memory (singleton repositories — InMemoryCategoryRepository, InMemoryTransactionRepository — persist data for the process lifetime)
typeChecking: C# compiler (nullable reference types enabled in all projects)
cicd: GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/ci.yml) — PR trigger on main/development; ubuntu-latest; restore → build Release → test Release; NuGet cache via actions/cache@v4
projectStructure:
src/backend/FinanceTracker/
├── Finance.Api/               ASP.NET Core Web API entry point
│   ├── Controllers/           TransactionsController, CategoriesController, ReportsController
│   └── Infrastructure/        ProblemDetailsMappers, Validators (TransactionValidator, CategoryValidator)
├── Finance.Business/          Business logic — all DTOs, services, report strategies
│   ├── Dtos/                  Request/response records (Categories, Transactions, Reports)
│   ├── Enums/                 ReportType
│   ├── Export/                TransactionCsvFormatter
│   ├── Mappers/               TransactionMapper, CategoryMapper
│   ├── Services/              ICategoryService, ITransactionService, IReportService + implementations
│   │   └── Reports/           IReportStrategy, ReportStrategyFactory, PeriodReportStrategy, IsoWeekReportStrategy
│   └── Validation/            ValidationResult, ValidationError
├── Finance.Data/              Domain entities and in-memory repositories
│   ├── Models/                Transaction, Category (records), TransactionType, CategoryType (enums)
│   └── Repositories/          IRepo interfaces + InMemory implementations (singleton)
├── Finance.Mcp/               MCP context/replay layer
│   ├── Client/                IMcpClient, McpClient
│   ├── Logging/               McpIterationLogger
│   ├── Redaction/             ContextRedactor
│   └── Schema/                MCP message types (ActionType, AgentActionRequest, McpContext, …)
├── Finance.Mcp.Host/          Executable MCP server host
│   └── Program.cs
└── tests/
    ├── Finance.Api.IntegrationTests/   WebApplicationFactory integration tests
    ├── Finance.Api.UnitTests/
    ├── Finance.Business.UnitTests/
    ├── Finance.Data.UnitTests/
    └── Finance.Mcp.UnitTests/
patterns: Three-layer architecture with strict one-way dependency: Finance.Api → Finance.Business → Finance.Data
Domain entities (Transaction, Category) are C# records — immutable by design
All DTOs are C# records defined in Finance.Business — API layer never sees domain entities
Report system uses Factory + Strategy pattern: ReportStrategyFactory resolves ReportType enum to IReportStrategy
Reports are ad-hoc — computed fresh on every request, never persisted or cached
Repositories are singletons; everything else (services, strategies, validators) is scoped
Multi-category transactions: Transaction.CategoryIds is IReadOnlyList<int> (non-empty); each category must be type-compatible with the transaction direction
OpenAPI enum schema transformer in Program.cs forces string-typed enums (prevents integer enum serialization mismatch)
MCP context/replay layer implemented as separate projects (Finance.Mcp, Finance.Mcp.Host) with redaction support for sensitive transaction descriptions
Scalar API UI gated behind IsDevelopment() — not exposed in Release builds
Integration tests use WebApplicationFactory<Program> with 'Testing' environment to skip HTTPS redirect middleware
xUnit v3 with Xunit.Assert only — FluentAssertions explicitly excluded
Moq strict-mode mocks used in Finance.Business.UnitTests and Finance.Api.UnitTests
